findings.finding: Scheduled accumulation (quantctl h39 scheduled-accumulate) strictly performs ingestion, disk safety checks, partition integrity verification, and atomic backup. It never invokes evaluate_feature_hypotheses or statistical inference. Systemd unit configures Nice=15, IOSchedulingPriority=7, MemoryMax=2G, CPUQuota=80% to protect system stability. Timer cadence (00:15 UTC) targets finalized partitions, preventing write contention with the active capture daemon. Failure never cascades to capture daemons.
findings.required_action: None. Low-interference, isolated operational design verified.

findings.finding: Source partitions are tracked in h39_source_partitions with SHA-256 hashes. Ingestion and integrity checks fail closed with RuntimeError('SOURCE_PARTITION_MUTATION: ...') if any finalized partition hash changes. Integrity breaches immediately set unblind readiness state to READINESS_BLOCKED_DATA_QUALITY.
findings.required_action: None. Tamper-detection and fail-closed behavior verified by unit tests.
